text:
Nadia: quick note
bout logging: sampler + redaction makes it hard to trace a problematic user across sampled logs. proposing 'fieldline' ids (tenant-scoped HMAC) so we can join without storing raw PII.
Theo: tenant HMAC sounds good. how do we handle replay? some teams need to re-run original request.
Nadia: we won't replay real PII by default. generate deterministic surrogates from the fieldline id for replay-only flows.
Ravi: need unredact for legal. extend breakglass: ticket+2 approvers+ephemeral KMS decrypt. log the unredact event.
Maya: console UX: show redacted value, fieldline id badge, and a "Show surrogate" action with watermark. make surrogate opt-in.
Theo: attachments/embeddings? fingerprint chunks instead of full ids.
Ravi: sampling: even at 0.5% sampled, fieldline ids let us correlate traces and metrics. good for debug.
Maya: rollout: phase1 telemetry-only emit field_id (2w), phase2 console canary (3w), phase3 debug pool+routing+quota (4w), phase4 enterprise unredact (6w).
OpsBot: feature-flag "fieldline_preview" created on eng-platform.
Nadia: I'll prototype middleware to HMAC sensitive fields and synth surrogates. PR will include perf numbers.
Theo: add header X-Debug-Mode for routing to debug pool. default off.
Maya: add runbook for unredact + support blurb for customers.
Ravi: monitor collisions, support tickets, and debug-pool abuse.
Nadia: thanks all, opening RFC now.
OpsBot: ticket RFC-1752220000-fieldline created (https://r.ticket/1752220000).
